l4_steps.name: Extract historical O&D traffic data
l4_steps.input: Planning cycle trigger; 24-month O&D booking history
l4_steps.output: Baseline O&D traffic dataset by market and quarter
l4_steps.pain_point: SkyCAST data feeds depend on Altéa PSS booking exports; delays in PSS batch jobs cause stale baseline traffic inputs, distorting forecasts for thin markets

l4_steps.name: Run demand forecast for planning horizon
l4_steps.input: Historical O&D dataset; macro-economic indices; event calendar
l4_steps.output: 12-month segment-level demand forecast by frequency band
l4_steps.pain_point: Thin LCC markets and new routes lack sufficient booking history; SkyCAST model defaults to industry averages, understating demand elasticity for fare-sensitive leisure segments

l4_steps.name: Validate forecast variance against prior cycle
l4_steps.input: Current forecast; prior planning cycle forecast
l4_steps.output: Variance report flagging markets with >5% deviation
l4_steps.kpi: Forecast variance report produced within 2 business days of data extraction
l4_steps.pain_point: Manual comparison between planning cycles is error-prone; no automated delta alerting in SkyCAST baseline module — analyst must export to Excel for comparison

l4_steps.name: Identify routes requiring capacity uplift
l4_steps.input: Validated demand forecast; current schedule frequencies
l4_steps.output: Prioritised list of routes with capacity gap ≥10 seats/day average
l4_steps.kpi: Capacity gap identification covering 100% of markets with forecast load factor ≥85%
l4_steps.pain_point: SkySYM network simulation does not natively import SkyCAST output in real time; manual CSV handoff between tools introduces reconciliation lag of 1–2 days

l4_steps.name: Run initial fleet assignment optimisation
l4_steps.input: Capacity gap list; available fleet inventory by subfleet
l4_steps.output: Draft fleet assignment plan with gauge per rotation
l4_steps.kpi: Fleet utilisation ≥13.5 block hours/aircraft/day across active rotations
l4_steps.pain_point: SkyMAX optimiser is sensitive to input parameter sequencing; incorrect fleet availability seeding (e.g., aircraft in scheduled maintenance not flagged) generates infeasible rotations that require manual correction

l4_steps.name: Detect constraint violations in fleet plan
l4_steps.kpi: Zero hard constraint violations (MTOW, turn-time) in approved plan
l4_steps.pain_point: SkyMAX surface-level constraint checker does not model real-time gate availability at congested airports (e.g., LHR, JFK slots); gate conflicts surface only post-filing via airport coordination

l4_steps.name: Adjust gauge on constrained rotations
l4_steps.input: Constraint violation report; alternate fleet availability
l4_steps.output: Revised gauge assignments with documented trade-off notes
l4_steps.kpi: All gauge adjustments resolved and re-optimised within 3 business days
l4_steps.pain_point: Downgrading gauge to resolve tail-count imbalance at outstations triggers yield loss on high-demand rotations; no automated revenue impact warning exists in SkyWORKS at point of gauge swap

l4_steps.name: Validate tail-count balance across network
l4_steps.input: Revised fleet assignment plan; overnight parking constraints by station
l4_steps.output: Balanced fleet assignment confirming overnight positions by station
l4_steps.kpi: Overnight positioning plan with zero unresolved imbalances before SSIM submission
l4_steps.pain_point: Overnight imbalances at spoke stations with no maintenance capability require costly ferry flights; SkyMAX does not auto-flag stations without MRO support when positioning aircraft

l4_steps.name: Assess slot and gate availability constraints
l4_steps.input: Validated fleet assignment plan; airport coordination level classifications
l4_steps.output: Slot availability matrix for Level 2/3 airports
l4_steps.kpi: 100% of Level 3 coordinated airports reviewed before SSIM submission
l4_steps.pain_point: Slot exchanges with competing carriers at Level 3 airports require bilateral negotiation through IATA slot conferences; lead times of 6–12 months compress planning windows for seasonal capacity changes

l4_steps.name: Review maintenance capacity windows
l4_steps.input: Fleet assignment plan; upcoming A/C-check and C-check schedules
l4_steps.output: Maintenance conflict report showing aircraft unavailability periods
l4_steps.kpi: Zero unplanned maintenance conflicts in 90-day rolling capacity plan
l4_steps.pain_point: AMOS maintenance window data is not directly integrated with SkyMAX fleet assignment; planners rely on manual exports and cross-referencing in spreadsheets, creating reconciliation errors during peak planning periods

l4_steps.name: Validate crew availability against planned capacity
l4_steps.input: Validated fleet assignment plan; crew headcount and qualification data
l4_steps.output: Crew coverage report by base and crew position
l4_steps.kpi: Crew coverage ratio ≥105% (buffer above minimum legal complement)
l4_steps.pain_point: Jeppesen Crew Management pairing outputs are built on published schedule; capacity changes post-pairing require full rerun of crew pairings, increasing planning cycle time by 3–5 days and risking FAR Part 117 duty-time compliance gaps

l4_steps.name: Resolve crew or slot deficits via capacity swap
l4_steps.input: Crew coverage report; slot availability matrix; maintenance conflict report
l4_steps.output: Revised capacity plan with documented frequency or gauge reductions
l4_steps.kpi: All crew and slot deficits resolved before SSIM filing deadline
l4_steps.pain_point: Reducing frequencies to resolve crew deficits at hub bases cascades into load factor pressure on remaining departures; decision lacks integrated revenue-impact modelling at point of resolution in SkyWORKS

l4_steps.name: Generate SSIM schedule file for submission
l4_steps.input: Approved capacity plan; airline designator codes and flight number series
l4_steps.kpi: SSIM file generated within 1 business day of capacity plan sign-off
l4_steps.pain_point: SkyWORKS SSIM export module requires manual mapping of codeshare flight suffixes for partner flights; errors in suffix formatting cause GDS rejection and require resubmission, delaying schedule availability by 24–48 hours

l4_steps.name: Validate SSIM file against IATA standards
l4_steps.output: Validation report; corrected SSIM file if errors found
l4_steps.kpi: Zero critical SSIM errors at point of GDS submission
l4_steps.pain_point: OAG validation catches structural SSIM errors but does not validate operational feasibility (e.g., turn-time violations at specific airports); operationally infeasible schedules pass SSIM validation and are caught only during operations

l4_steps.name: Submit validated schedule to GDS and NDC channels
l4_steps.system: Amadeus GDS / Sabre GDS / NDC API Gateway
l4_steps.output: Schedule live in Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport, and NDC channel
l4_steps.kpi: Schedule available in all GDS channels within 4 hours of SSIM submission; NDC availability within 2 hours
l4_steps.pain_point: Travelport GDS schedule updates lag Amadeus and Sabre by up to 6 hours due to batch processing cadence; passengers booking via Travelport-connected TMCs may see stale capacity, resulting in overbooking conflicts at check-in

l4_steps.name: Monitor in-period seat utilization vs forecast
l4_steps.input: Live booking data; capacity plan baseline
l4_steps.output: Weekly utilization dashboard by market and departure date
l4_steps.kpi: System load factor ≥83% on average across active network; individual market load factor reviewed weekly
l4_steps.pain_point: Amadeus NRM monitors inventory at O&D level but does not natively surface segment-level spill and recapture estimates; capacity reoptimisation decisions rely on analyst judgment without automated spill quantification

l4_steps.name: Trigger capacity reoptimisation for underperforming routes
l4_steps.input: Utilization dashboard; routes with load factor <78% within 60 days of departure
l4_steps.output: Reoptimisation recommendation: frequency reduction, gauge swap, or fare stimulus
l4_steps.kpi: Reoptimisation recommendation issued within 48 hours of load factor breach trigger
l4_steps.pain_point: Within-60-day capacity changes require coordinated updates across Altéa PSS (inventory), SkyWORKS (schedule), and Jeppesen Crew (pairings); the lack of a unified change-management workflow causes synchronisation failures and involuntary passenger re-accommodation

l4_steps.name: Log final utilization KPIs and close planning cycle
l4_steps.input: Post-departure load factor actuals; forecast baseline
l4_steps.output: Post-cycle capacity utilization report with variance analysis
l4_steps.kpi: Post-cycle report published within 5 business days of season end; forecast vs actual load factor variance documented for model calibration
l4_steps.pain_point: Redshift data pipeline aggregates actuals from Altéa PSS on a 24-hour delay; post-departure analysis for redeye and overnight flights often reflects next-day timestamps, distorting daily load factor KPIs in Tableau dashboards
